units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY FIREFIGHTER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Firefighter of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly professional personnel of the State Fire Service and departmental fire protection services for merits in strengthening fire safety and active fire prevention work, outstanding results in extinguishing and preventing fires and protecting the population and city facilities from fire, repeated participation in eliminating the consequences of accidents, disasters and natural calamities and the bravery and courage shown therein, effective operation and maintenance of firefighting equipment and machinery, and skilful education and training of personnel, provided that they have served in the City of Moscow for at least 10 calendar years.

units.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Inventor of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on authors of inventions, utility models and industrial designs that have been put into practical use, for merits in developing new equipment and technologies and many years of productive inventive activity, who have made a major personal contribution to the socioeconomic development of Moscow and have worked in the city for at least 15 years.

units.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Worker in Control (Supervisory) Activities of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly qualified persons holding state offices of the City of Moscow, state civil servants serving in the executive authorities of the City of Moscow, federal executive authorities and other state bodies, and employees of institutions exercising control (supervisory) powers in the territory of the City of Moscow, for merits in control (supervisory) activities and a major personal contribution to organising and exercising state control (supervision) and municipal control in the territory of the City of Moscow, provided that they have worked in control (supervisory) activities in the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.

units.label: Point 2 · “The distinction ‘For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow’…”

units.locator: THE BREAST BADGE ‘LAUREATE OF THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’, AND THE BREAST BADGE FOR PROFESSIONAL HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: On the front of the distinction, in the centre of the cartouche, is an applied round medallion with an applied relief image of the Government of Moscow building (13 Tverskaya Street). The inscription ‘FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ runs around the edge of the medallion. In an oval recess in the lower part of the cartouche are the Roman numerals ‘XX’, ‘XXV’, ‘XXX’, ‘XL’ or ‘L’, denoting the number of years of impeccable service, covered in dark red enamel. Two laurel branches crossing at their bases frame the oval with the numerals from below. The medallions of the XL and L (years) distinctions are enamelled.

units.locator: THE BREAST BADGE ‘LAUREATE OF THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’, AND THE BREAST BADGE FOR PROFESSIONAL HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The reverse of the honorary badge of the City of Moscow bears an inscription giving the name of the honorary badge of the City of Moscow, a device for fastening it to clothing, and the number of the honorary badge of the City of Moscow.
